title: Obama 2008 family learn more combination win

change.control: Original campaign splash page and signup button.
change.variant: Combine the Family image with the Learn More button, combination 11.

quote: That’s an improvement of 40.6% in sign-up rate.
notes: Firsthand report by campaign analytics director Dan Siroker. Combined-recipe contrast from the same 24-combination test as the factor records, not an independent study. Counts transcribed from the inline Combinations figure. Original rate 8.26%; variant 11.6%. Claimed extra $60 million is extrapolated, not directly observed randomized donation revenue.
